global.description: Platform values (global.okdp): the context's layers, the platform's (platform.yaml) then its project's (project.yaml), never an instance's.

hiveCatalogs.title: Hive catalogs
hiveCatalogs.description: Hive catalogs, one Trino catalog per item, each on its own metastore and object store.

metastore.title: Metastore
metastore.description: Hive metastore connection backing this catalog.

storage.title: Object store
storage.description: S3 object store backing this catalog: the name of a connection, of an output of another instance of the namespace, or of a named claim of the project (a bucket the metastore or the catalog's writers claim too); or a claim, a bucket of its own ({}, {class: <class>}).

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: S3 identity used against this store. Secret with keys: accessKey, secretKey. Defaults to the instance s3SecretRef, then to the storage connection's credentials Secret (secretRef).

icebergCatalogs.title: Iceberg REST catalogs
icebergCatalogs.description: Iceberg REST catalogs (Polaris), one Trino catalog per item, each on its own object store.

storage.title: Object store
storage.description: S3 object store backing this catalog: the name of a connection, of an output of another instance of the namespace, or of a named claim of the project (a bucket the metastore or the catalog's writers claim too); or a claim, a bucket of its own ({}, {class: <class>}).

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.description: Polaris catalog used as the warehouse. Defaults to the realm published on the connection.

oidcSecretRef.title: OAuth client secret
oidcSecretRef.description: OAuth client Trino uses against this catalog. Secret with keys: client_id, client_secret. Defaults to creds-<release>-oauth2.

oauth2Scope.title: OAuth2 scope
oauth2Scope.description: OAuth2 scope requested. Polaris rejects the connector default.

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: S3 identity used against this store. Secret with keys: accessKey, secretKey. Defaults to the instance s3SecretRef, then to the storage connection's credentials Secret (secretRef).

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: Default S3 identity of this instance, used by any catalog that does not name its own. Secret with keys: accessKey, secretKey.

workerCpu.title: Worker CPU (vCPU)
workerCpu.description: Worker CPU request in vCPU. The limit is twice the request.

workerMemoryGi.title: Worker memory (GiB)
workerMemoryGi.description: Worker memory request in GiB. The limit is twice the request.

coordinatorMemoryGi.title: Coordinator memory (GiB)
coordinatorMemoryGi.description: Coordinator memory limit in GiB (request: 1 GiB).

enableOPAL.title: Enable OPAL
enableOPAL.description: Whether to enable OPAL. When false, OPA policies are loaded by the kube-mgmt sidecar from the ConfigMaps labelled openpolicyagent.org/policy: <release>-opa (data: openpolicyagent.org/data: <release>-opa).

enableOPADebugLogs.title: Debug logs
enableOPADebugLogs.description: Log OPA status and decision logs to the container console, and the requests Trino sends to OPA and its answers (opa.log-requests, opa.log-responses). Verbose, intended for debugging.

policyRepoUrl.title: Policy repository
policyRepoUrl.description: OPA policy repo URL. The default, OKDP's okdp-examples, is an example to try OPAL with, not a source to trust: its policy is whatever its branch holds when OPAL polls it, and decides who reads what. Set your own repository, with the branch only your policy authors write.

OPAL_POLICY_SUBSCRIPTION_DIRS.title: Policy directories
OPAL_POLICY_SUBSCRIPTION_DIRS.description: Policy directories in the repository for which the client will subscribe to, separated by ':'.

OPAL_POLICY_REPO_MANIFEST_PATH.title: Policy manifest path
OPAL_POLICY_REPO_MANIFEST_PATH.description: The location of the manifest file in the remote repository.

opaPolicyPath.title: Policy path
opaPolicyPath.description: Path of the OPA policies for Trino used in the Trino variable opa.policy.uri.

oauth2AdditionalAudiences.title: Additional OAuth2 audiences
oauth2AdditionalAudiences.description: Audiences of the tokens the OAuth2 authenticator accepts beside the instance's client (http-server.authentication.oauth2.additional-audiences): the audience the control plane's SQL editor exchanges its tokens for (sqlEditor.tokenExchangeAudience of okdp-control-plane-server), which an instance whose client is registered by DCR needs.

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream charts this chart renders, one object per chart, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

trino.title: trino
trino.description: Values of the trino chart 1.42.2 (https://trinodb.github.io/charts), for example image, resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, server.config.query, extra catalogs. Refused: fullnameOverride, server.config.authenticationType, server.config.https, server.coordinatorExtraConfig, auth, accessControl, ingress.enabled/className/hosts/tls. Appended to the lists this chart sets: env, additionalConfigProperties, coordinator/worker additionalVolumes, additionalVolumeMounts and additionalJVMConfig.

opa-kube-mgmt.title: opa-kube-mgmt
opa-kube-mgmt.description: Values of the opa-kube-mgmt chart 11.0.12 (https://open-policy-agent.github.io/kube-mgmt/charts), rendered when enableOPA is set: image, resources, extraArgs, ... Refused: fullnameOverride, authz, useHttps, port, admissionController, prometheus, serviceMonitor, mgmt.enabled, rbac.create, serviceAccount.create. Appended: extraArgs.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
